json-function.reason: The audit row's before/requested/after payload is assembled from subqueries inside the same batch as the mutation, so it observes exactly the state the write saw. Building it in TypeScript would need a separate read and lose that. Postgres form is json_build_object.

pragma.reason: Column introspection that decides whether a session-storage migration still has work to do. Postgres reads information_schema instead; there is no shared spelling.
